note: Missing `id`. There is no default credential, and an absent id must not read as 'all of them'.
Empty `id`. minLength guards the shape that would otherwise reach a maintainer's storage layer as a prefix scan.
Unbounded `reason` — §7.3 item 19. The member lands in an audit trail; maxLength is what keeps a write there bounded.
Bare/unnamespaced ext key — SPEC §4.5.1 requires every immediate child of ext to be reverse-DNS namespaced.
Unknown top-level member — additionalProperties: false catches `lifecycle`. A consumer names the credential and the verb; it does not assert the resulting state.
